tasks.prompt: Inspect service.py and config.json. Implement route_for(path) using the routes mapping and default_route from config.json. Exact matches win; unknown paths use the configured default. Do not hard-code individual route values. Read config.json freshly on every call so changes take effect without reimporting service.py.

fixture.checks:
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/work')
import service
from pathlib import Path
originals={p:p.read_bytes() for p in Path("/work").glob("*.json")}
try:
    assert service.route_for("/health")=="health"
    assert service.route_for("/missing")=="fallback"
    import json
    p=Path("/work/config.json")
    v=json.loads(p.read_text());v["routes"]["/health"]="changed";p.write_text(json.dumps(v))
    assert service.route_for("/health")=="changed"
    print('ACCEPTANCE_CHECKS_PASSED')
finally:
    for p, data in originals.items():
        p.write_bytes(data)
